title: A run incarnation ended with no terminal checkpoint: seq 39 running, then seq 40 admitted
body: epic-ncv's checkpoint went from sequence 39 ('z23 is running', 2026-09-18 16:39) straight to 40 ('admitted', 16:50) with no failed or stopped state in between. Whatever ended that incarnation, whether a kill, a crash or a deliberate restart, left no record, so it is invisible to any count of interventions or restarts. A new incarnation should record that its predecessor ended without a terminal state.
